title: Restart a Selected Robot From the Robot Selection Screen
summary: Use the OptiSweep RMS Robot Selection screen to restart a specific robot by entering/selecting its robot ID and clicking the “Restart” action. Confirm the robot restarts at the restart point or on the QR code cell, and verify the positioned robot appears on the station map.
when_to_use: When a specific robot needs to be restarted from the RMS Robot Selection screen, and you must confirm the robot restarts at the restart point/QR code cell and then appears on the station map.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the restart from the RMS Robot Selection screen by entering/selecting the robot ID and clicking “Restart”, then verify the robot’s presence on the station map after it starts.
safety_notes: If the robot does not restart or does not appear on the station map after the restart action, stop and escalate to support.
access_or_tools_needed: Robot Selection screen (HMI) for restarting robots
Station map display on the same HMI

visual_references.description: Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen showing: enter/select robot ID, click “Restart”, and the restart point/QR code cell + post-start station map display.
Robot Selection overview showing robot selection behavior and robot ID details used to identify the correct robot.
Robot Selection Restart slide text referencing restart point/QR code cell context and robot ID/location verification via node code/cell code.
Robot restart process notes including the restart point/QR code cell behavior and the expectation that the robot is displayed on the map after starting.
Additional Robot Selection Restart slide context (includes restart point/QR code cell and post-start map display).

steps.title: Open the Robot Selection screen
steps.purpose: Access the HMI controls needed to restart a specific robot.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS Robot Selection screen that contains the “Restart Robot” workflow.
steps.expected_result: The Robot Selection screen is visible with the controls to enter/select a robot and the “Restart” action.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Robot Selection UI elements for selecting a robot and initiating “Restart”.
steps.failure_condition: The Robot Selection screen (or the “Restart” action) is not accessible/visible.

actions.label: Open Robot Selection screen
actions.exact_action: Open the Robot Selection screen shown in the Robot Selection / Restart Robot workflow.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot access the Robot Selection screen or the “Restart” control, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Segment 0031 shows the Robot Selection / Restart Robot screen workflow (enter/select robot ID, click “Restart”, restart point/QR code cell, and post-start station map display).

steps.title: Enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot
steps.purpose: Identify the exact robot to restart.
steps.instruction: On the Robot Selection screen, enter the corresponding robot ID or select the robot on the screen.
steps.expected_result: The intended robot is selected/identified on the Robot Selection screen (so you can proceed to click “Restart”).
steps.healthy_condition: The robot selection shows the robot details panel including the robot ID (and selection state) for the robot you intend to restart.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm the correct robot ID/selection before restarting.

actions.label: Select robot by ID
actions.exact_action: Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confidently identify the correct robot ID/selection, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/slide text: “1. Enter the corresponding robot Id or select the robot.”
Robot Selection overview: selecting a robot shows robot details including robot ID.

steps.title: Click the "Restart" button
steps.purpose: Trigger the restart action for the selected robot.
steps.instruction: Click the “Restart” button on the Robot Selection screen for the selected robot.
steps.expected_result: The restart action is initiated for the selected robot.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Restart” action is clicked for the selected robot (per the Robot Selection / Restart Robot workflow).
steps.failure_condition: The restart action cannot be triggered (button not available) or you are unsure it applied to the selected robot.
stop_or_escalate_if: If the “Restart” button is not available or you cannot confirm the restart was initiated for the selected robot, stop and escalate to support.

steps.title: Wait for the robot to restart at the restart point or QR code cell
steps.purpose: Ensure the restart completes and the robot is positioned correctly per the restart requirement.
steps.instruction: After clicking “Restart”, wait for the robot to restart and confirm it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
steps.expected_result: The robot restarts and is positioned at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot’s position corresponds to the restart point/QR code cell context described in the Robot Selection / Restart Robot workflow.
steps.failure_condition: The robot does not restart or does not reach the restart point/QR code cell position.

actions.label: Confirm restart position
actions.exact_action: Confirm the robot is at the restart point or on the QR code cell.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the robot does not restart or does not reach the restart point/QR code cell, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/slide text: “3. The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”
Robot Selection Restart slide text reiterates: “The robot will restart (it is at the restart point or on the QR code cell).”

steps.title: Verify the positioned robot is displayed on the station map
steps.purpose: Confirm the restart resulted in the robot being shown in the correct location on the station map.
steps.instruction: After the robot starts, verify that the positioned robot is displayed on the station map on the same HMI.
steps.expected_result: The positioned robot appears on the station map after the restart.
steps.healthy_condition: On the station map, the robot you restarted is shown in the positioned state/location after it starts.
steps.failure_condition: After starting, the positioned robot does not appear on the station map.

actions.label: Check station map display
actions.exact_action: Verify the positioned robot is displayed on the station map.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the positioned robot does not appear on the station map after the restart action, stop and escalate to support.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR/slide text: “4. After starting, the robot that has been positioned will be displayed on the station map.”

Restart process notes include: if the robot is not on the map after restart, it is because it can’t see a label (flashing blue sign), and clearing the condition results in the robot showing successfully on the map.

success_criteria: After starting, the positioned robot is displayed on the station map.
healthy_conditions: Robot restart completes at the restart point or on the QR code cell.
The positioned robot appears on the station map after it starts.
failure_conditions: The positioned robot does not appear on the station map after the restart action.
escalation_guidance: If the robot does not restart or the positioned robot does not appear on the station map after the restart action, stop and escalate to support.
